title: Team Configurator: compact cards, edge cases, and service account flows
content:
Purpose and scope:
This is a working doc for a compact, card-first Team Configurator surface in Console. Goal: provide a single, scannable team page that balances quick actions (invite, create SA, rotate keys) with clear RBAC visibility and a lightweight audit trail preview. Target audiences: org admins, security reviewers, platform engineers.

High-level UX premise:
- Compact cards per team (or tenant) that surface 1-line summary, role count, active API keys, recent critical events. Cards collapse/expand to show members and service accounts.
- Primary CTA on each card: Manage (opens full panel) + quick actions in overflow menu (Invite, Create SA, Revoke keys).
- Keyboard-first interactions and small-screen optimized stacks: cards become a list with swipeable quick actions on mobile.

Proposed screens / flows (wireframe notes):
1) Team Grid (desktop) / List (mobile)
   - Left: Search + role filter (owner, admin, developer, view-only) + tag chips (sso-enabled, restricted-keys).
   - Center: Cards (max 6 per row responsive down to 1). Card elements: team name, small org badge, member count, SA count, active keys count, latency SLO indicator (green/yellow/red), last security event timestamp.
   - Right: Activity peek (compact audit timeline) showing top 3 recent events across all teams with quick-link to expanded audit view.
   - Empty state copy: "No teams match—try clearing filters or invite a teammate."

2) Card expand (in-place panel)
   - Header: team name, edit settings icon, three-dot menu for bulk actions.
   - Tabs (compact): Members | Service Accounts & Keys | Policies | Audit Peek
   - Members: inline editable role chips next to names (hover reveals 'change role' and 'impersonate' actions); pagination when >25.
   - Service Accounts & Keys: list SAs with their last-use timestamp, attached roles, and key badges (ephemeral / persistent). Key actions: rotate, revoke, download (download only on creation), copy token. Token copy shows ephemeral warning modal if token lifetime > 1h.
   - Policies: display active RBAC policies + inheritance indicators (org -> team). Quick link to policy simulator (sandbox).
   - Audit Peek: top 5 events for this team with expand-per-event. If events > 100, show link to full Audit Log filtered.

3) Create Service Account modal (first-run and regular)
   - Step 1: name + description + TTL (select from presets: 1h, 24h, 7d, never).
   - Step 2: attach roles (searchable) + optional metadata tags for use-case. Show inline cost/usage hint if SA will be used for heavy embedding or hosting.
   - Step 3: keys: create ephemeral by default (recommended) with toggle to create persistent key. Persisent creation requires justification and triggers an audit checkpoint.
   - Post-create: single-shot secret reveal with clear instructions + "rotate" quick-link mapped to the SA entry. Warn about download-only copy.

Accessibility and keyboard patterns:
- All cards and actions reachable by keyboard. Focus trap inside modals.
- Role-change dropdown supports arrow keys and type-ahead.
- Copy token uses aria-live announcement and hides token value to screen readers unless explicit reveal permission is toggled.

Audit log view ideas (lightweight team-first):
- Quick filters: by actor, resource (team/SA/key), action type (create/rotate/revoke), timeframe. Offer sample saved filter presets: "Recent key rotations", "Failed auth attempts", "Privilege escalations".
- Event detail pane: shows before/after policy diff where applicable, IP, region, device, request id. Inline links resolve to related tickets/PRs.
- Anomaly highlight: ML-backed flag that surfaces unusual patterns (e.g., key used from new region + large token usage). Flagged events get color strip and suggested actions (revoke, rotate, open incident).

Edge cases & open questions (needs product review):
- Nested teams: visualize member inheritance. If user belongs to both org-admin and team-admin, show highest privilege and allow policy simulator to show effective permission.
- Service accounts used by external vendors: require additional checkbox "third-party access" and forced rotation policy. How to represent vendor attribution in the card?
- Cross-team keys (shared SAs): do we show them on both team cards? Proposed: highlight primary owner team and show reference on other teams with link back to owner.
- Long audit histories: for large customers, we need pagination or streaming and not to eager-load all event details. Implement cursor-based fetch with sentinel UI.

Polished microcopy suggestions:
- Key creation success: "Secret created — this is the only time the key will be visible. Store it now in your vault."
- Ephemeral key hint: "Expires in 1 hour. Recommended for most CI/CD and local dev use."
- Role change confirm: "Changing this user’s role affects runtime permissions. Call out the exact resources impacted."

Backlog (initial prioritization):
- P0: compact cards + card expand with Members and SA list (TEAM-4123)
- P0: single-shot secret reveal flow + copy behavior and telemetry (SEC-298)
- P1: team-first audit peek + full filter integration (OBS-201)
- P1: policy simulator integration in Policies tab (POL-182)
- P2: anomaly highlight and suggested actions (ML-67)
- P2: mobile swipe actions + small-screen quick-create SA (UX-501)

Telemetry & Signals to instrument:
- Card expand rate, quick-action click-through, ephemeral vs persistent key selection %, copy-to-clipboard rate, post-rotate usage of rotated key.
- Audit filter saved/used counts and anomaly flag dismissals.

Rollout & experiment plan:
- Beta for 10 orgs (mix of small and large customers) behind feature flag. Collect qualitative feedback via short in-console survey and 1:1 interviews.
- Gate full rollout on: fewer than 5 support incidents related to key discovery, + >75% copy/rotation success metric, + no critical security regressions in first 2 weeks.

Open design / PM questions for sync:
- Default TTL presets — should we expand to org-level policy override?
- Visible indicators for delegated roles vs inherited roles — how do we surface conflict resolution in the UI?
- What is the exact justification flow for persistent keys (audit ticket creation or in-console justification text)?

Next steps (owners):
- UX: create high-fidelity cards and responsive spec (Owner: Priya, due 2024-10-14).
- Eng: spike on audit-peek streaming API and server-side cursor model (Owner: Liam, due 2024-10-07).
- Security: finalize persistent key approval flow and audit hooks (Owner: Noah, due 2024-10-10).

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally compact; there will be a follow-up doc with expanded policy simulator wires and the full audit page treatment. Please call out any compliance constraints we missed for customers in APAC/EU (data residency for audit contents).

Raw sketches and quick links:
- Sketch 1: team grid with expanded card (attached in Figma link in Confluence).
- Sketch 2: ephemeral-key-first modal variants.

End of doc.
